messages:
Avery Chen (CEO): Quick weekly note 1; three priorities this sprint:
1) Policy: rolling update to data-retention defaults 1; hosted = 30d, enterprise opt-in = 90d. Product + Legal to publish short FAQ by Thu.
2) Launch: Private GA target remains end of next week but only if Security signoff and install docs are in place. No shortcuts.
3) Metrics: aim for hosted p95 <= 210ms for paid routes; call out regressions in the daily stand.
Also: temporary pause on non-customer-facing hiring for two sprints to preserve runway.

Nikhil Rao (VP Eng): noted. We'll reserve a small team to finish reliability items and the install doc. Spinning up an infra sync Thu 10:00 PT.

Priya Reddy (VP Product): FAQ draft incoming in 3 hours. Will add clear signoff checklist and CI links.

Leah Kim (Finance): If GA slides, well reforecast Q2 numbers. Good to know hiring pause window.

Zoe Park (Head of People): People-ops will send a short note to managers explaining the hiring pause and exceptions process.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release/2026-03-29 -> canary-b (2 hosts).

Nikhil Rao (VP Eng): running smoke now:
./infra/smoke.sh --env=canary-b --suite=core

Nikhil Rao (VP Eng): quick smoke: p95=188ms, 0.1% errors. Posting full logs to the canary ticket.

Avery Chen (CEO): thanks team. Keep updates short; escalate any blocker immediately.
